theorems.name: Submission.dimred_minimizing_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → n ≤ d → d ≤ P → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) ∧ (N = univ → ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), ball y R ⊆ U → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) ∧ (∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ U, HasMassDensity T y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U) ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity T y θ → 1 ≤ θ
